title: Lesson 3 Checkpoint — Present Continuous for Future
description: Show what you learned about present continuous for future. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: I am meeting the team at 3.
Me am meeting the team at 3.
I am meeting the team at 3.
questions.answer: I am meeting the team at 3.
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Present Continuous for Future: Am/is/are + -ing for arranged future: I am meeting John at 6.
